While airborne, any kill or 5 hits against an <link Elite, Miniboss, or Boss [#CombatantClassifications] /> <title refills [G_refill] /> 12 ammo and grants a 15HP <void/>Void Overshield for 6 seconds (9 seconds with <void/>Echo of Persistance).

1 second cooldown when activated by hits. 

No cooldown when activated by kills.
